templates.html:
<fieldset class="lg" style="--accent:{{accent}};">
  <legend class="lg__legend lg__legend--{{position}}{{#if bold}} lg__legend--bold{{/if}}">{{legendText}}</legend>
  <label class="lg__opt"><input type="checkbox" checked> Email</label>
  <label class="lg__opt"><input type="checkbox"> SMS</label>
</fieldset>
<style>
.lg { width: 280px; box-sizing: border-box; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #241430; background: #FAF7F2; border: 1.5px solid #24143025; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 18px 16px; }
.lg__legend { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }
.lg__legend--inline { padding: 0 6px; font-size: 13px; }
.lg__legend--block { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 6px 0 10px; font-size: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #24143020; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.lg__legend--bold { font-weight: 800; }
.lg__opt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 14px; }
.lg__opt input { accent-color: var(--accent); width: 16px; height: 16px; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<fieldset class="w-[280px] box-border font-sans text-sm text-[#241430] bg-[#FAF7F2] border-[1.5px] border-[#24143025] rounded-[10px] px-[18px] pt-2 pb-4">
  <legend class="lg-tw-legend lg-tw-legend--{{position}} font-medium{{#if bold}} font-extrabold{{/if}}" style="color:{{accent}}">{{legendText}}</legend>
  <label class="flex items-center gap-2 py-1.5 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" class="w-4 h-4" style="accent-color:{{accent}}" checked> Email</label>
  <label class="flex items-center gap-2 py-1.5 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" class="w-4 h-4" style="accent-color:{{accent}}"> SMS</label>
</fieldset>
<style>
.lg-tw-legend--inline { padding: 0 6px; font-size: 13px; }
.lg-tw-legend--block { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 6px 0 10px; font-size: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #24143020; margin-bottom: 6px; }
</style>
